title: What If You Were Stuck in a Time Loop Until You Beat Prime Michael Phelps?
description:
You close your eyes on an inflatable flamingo in a hotel pool. When you open them, you're standing on a starting block in a swim cap and goggles you don't remember putting on. It's Beijing, August 12th, 2008, the men's 200 meter freestyle final at the Olympics, and the very tall man a few blocks over is Michael Phelps. Like more than half of Americans, you can't really swim.

He touches the wall in 1:42.96, a new world record. You're still on your second length, holding the rope between the lanes. Then you're standing on the block again. Every time the last swimmer touches the wall, the race starts over, and everyone forgets except you. Tiredness, injuries and hunger are wiped every time, you never get older, and your body keeps every bit of muscle it builds. The only way out is to touch the wall before him.

How long would you keep swimming? Tell me in the comments

title: What If You Could See Who Is Secretly Attracted to You?
description:
What If You Could See Who Is Secretly Attracted to You?

You get on the bus, and the only empty seat is next to Sloane Avery. "Um. No. Find another seat." She's glowing. Bright pink, head to toe, like a neon sign, and nobody else on the bus even looks. "There aren't any." "Then stand." She gets brighter. By the time you sit down, she's so bright the window is pink. She has no idea you can see it.

At first it's amazing. In science you pick your partner by looking for pink. There's a note in your locker that says "I think you're cute," and down the hall one girl is as pink as a flamingo. Your little sister's best friend glows like a night-light and gives you all her fruit snacks. You've never asked a girl anything in your life, and now you just ask, because if she's glowing it isn't really asking. Forty lights at the county fair. A seat at the eighth-grade table. A ride on the fire truck in the Christmas parade. Sixty-three carnations on Valentine's Day, and not one of them signed. You know exactly who sent every single one.

Then one morning a light you were counting on just isn't there anymore, and you have no idea when it stopped. The glow shows you who likes you. It shows you everything else, too. Your best friend has loved the same girl since fourth grade, and she glows for you. And at the spring dance, with four hundred kids watching, you walk away from seventy-one lights toward the one that's off.

Would you want to see who's secretly attracted to you, or would you rather not know? Tell us in the comments.

Is any of this real? The science in this episode:
- The people who are liked, and don't like back, tell the unhappier stories. College students wrote accounts of one-sided love from both sides. The would-be lovers looked back with both good and painful feelings; the accounts of the people who'd been liked were "more uniformly negative." They saw themselves as innocent but still felt guilty, and didn't know how they were supposed to act. Baumeister, Wotman & Stillwell (1993), "Unrequited love: On heartbreak, anger, guilt, scriptlessness, and humiliation", Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 64(3).
- About two out of three couples were friends first. Across seven samples of nearly 1,900 university students and adults, 68% said their current or most recent romantic relationship began as a friendship. Stinson, Cameron & Hoplock (2021), "The Friends-to-Lovers Pathway to Romance", Social Psychological and Personality Science.

title: What If You Relived One Race Until You Beat Usain Bolt?
description:
What if you had to relive one race until you beat Usain Bolt?

Berlin, 2009. The fastest 100 meters ever run. Every time you lose, you're back in the blocks. The world resets, but your legs keep everything they learn. So you train the only way you can: one sprint at a time, against the fastest man in history.

Ten thousand races to break 10 seconds. Twenty thousand to hit a wall two hundredths behind him. And then you find the only place Bolt is ordinary: the start.

Real numbers inside: Bolt's reaction time in Berlin, his 41 strides, his top speed, the false-start rule that disqualified him in 2011, and the scientist who calculated the human limit.

Would you take 40,000 losses for one win?

title: What IF School Assigned Your Crush as YOUR WIFE?
description:
💍❤️ What IF School Assigned Your Crush as YOUR WIFE?

Imagine walking into school expecting a completely normal day... until your principal announces the CRAZIEST school assignment EVER! 😳

Every student must participate in a pretend marriage project, where they're assigned a husband or wife for an entire WEEK!

And somehow, out of EVERYONE in your school...

YOU GET PAIRED WITH YOUR CRUSH! 😍💘

Yes. THAT crush. The person you've secretly liked for YEARS. The person who makes you forget how to speak whenever they smile at you.

And now they're officially your pretend WIFE!

At first, it sounds like the ultimate dream come true. You finally get to spend every day together, sit next to each other in class, and experience what being a married couple might actually be like!

But there's one BIG problem...

YOU HAVE ABSOLUTELY NO IDEA HOW MARRIAGE WORKS! 💀😂

From managing imaginary bills and planning your dream home to dealing with embarrassing classmates, awkward conversations, and unexpected romantic moments, this school project quickly turns into absolute CHAOS!

💍 Will your crush actually enjoy being your pretend wife?
❤️ Could this assignment make your crush fall in love with you?
😂 Can you survive an entire week of pretend married life?
😳 What happens when everyone at school starts shipping you together?
💘 And what if your crush secretly likes you BACK?

As the week goes on, you start discovering things about your crush that you never knew before. But when the assignment finally ends, will everything go back to normal... or could your pretend marriage turn into a REAL relationship? 👀

In this hilarious and romantic animated What If scenario, we explore what would happen if your school randomly assigned YOUR CRUSH as your wife!

Expect funny moments, embarrassing situations, unexpected confessions, romantic surprises, and plenty of crazy twists!
